name: orbit-typecheck-native
description: TypeScript 7 (the native compiler) for the Vercel build's type-check, run by `npm run typecheck:fast`. Its own package on purpose: installed beside the root `typescript` its `tsc` bin would replace it, and typescript-eslint (peer typescript <6.1) needs the root one's API. Install with `npm ci --prefix scripts/ts7` (vercel.json's installCommand does).
